name: Valued Advisers Trust - m+ DualYield Autocall ETF
name_en: Valued Advisers Trust - m+ DualYield Autocall ETF
desc: Under normal market conditions, seeks to invest at least 80% of its net assets plus any borrowings for investment purposes in unfunded total return swaps (based on their notional value) that provide exposure to the S&P 500 Futures 40% Defined Volatility Autocall Index (USD) TR (the “Autocall Index”). It is non-diversified.
